fields.q: 我饿极了的时候，你可别离我太近。很抱歉，你看起来真的很好吃。
fields.en: Be careful not to get too near me when I'm really hungry. You do look delicious, I'm sorry to say.
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 我饿极了的时候，你可别离我太近。很抱歉，你看起来真的很好吃。

en.value: Be careful not to get too near me when I'm really hungry. You do look delicious, I'm sorry to say.

fields.q: 索雷尔大人很棒吧？他那么温柔、厉害，就是好得不得了！
fields.en: Don't you think Lord Solel is wonderful? He's so kind, amazing, and just plain great!
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 索雷尔大人很棒吧？他那么温柔、厉害，就是好得不得了！

en.value: Don't you think Lord Solel is wonderful? He's so kind, amazing, and just plain great!

fields.q: 我从小就在爸爸和朋友们的宴会上大吃大喝。要是我办那样的大派对，你要来吗？
fields.en: I grew up enjoying food at my dad's feasts with his friends. If I have a big party like that, want to come?
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 我从小就在爸爸和朋友们的宴会上大吃大喝。要是我办那样的大派对，你要来吗？

en.value: I grew up enjoying food at my dad's feasts with his friends. If I have a big party like that, want to come?

fields.q: 我胃口超好。神殿给的薪水根本不够我吃饭。很惨吧？
fields.en: I have a VERY healthy appetite. The pay I get from the temple can't cover my meals. Tragic, right?
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 我胃口超好。神殿给的薪水根本不够我吃饭。很惨吧？

en.value: I have a VERY healthy appetite. The pay I get from the temple can't cover my meals. Tragic, right?

fields.q: 我喜欢给大家取可爱的小名。希望是可爱的啦。会不会有点怪？
fields.en: I like to give everyone cute little names. I hope it's cute anyway. Maybe it's kind of weird?
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 我喜欢给大家取可爱的小名。希望是可爱的啦。会不会有点怪？

fields.q: 我最爱吃辣了。可惜总是一下就被吃光。这是为什么呢？
fields.en: I love spicy food more than anything. Too bad it always gets eaten up quick. Why is that, I wonder?
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 我最爱吃辣了。可惜总是一下就被吃光。这是为什么呢？

en.value: I love spicy food more than anything. Too bad it always gets eaten up quick. Why is that, I wonder?

fields.q: 不管喝多少杯麦酒我都不会醉。你呢？
fields.en: I never get tipsy, no matter how many mugs of suds I drink. How about you?
fields.name: 索绯雅

q.value: 不管喝多少杯麦酒我都不会醉。你呢？

en.value: I never get tipsy, no matter how many mugs of suds I drink. How about you?

fields.q: 我在里奥珊堡出生长大。你要是去那儿，可要当心那里的地痞！
fields.en: I was born and raised at Lyoshan Fort. If you ever go there, watch out for all the ruffians!
fields.name: 索绯雅

fields.q: 觉得谁可爱，我就忍不住给他取个有趣的名字。我要叫你「小鸟鸟」！
fields.en: If I think someone's cute, I can't help calling them a fun name. I'm going to call you Li'l Birdie!
fields.name: 索绯雅
